prompt: A clay tablet covered in rows of small wedge-shaped marks, held in two hands, in a sunny courtyard of ancient Mesopotamia with a mud-brick building behind. The first writing.

Three tools side by side on a plain wooden table, nothing else: a chipped grey stone hand axe, a golden-brown bronze axe head on a wooden handle, and a dark grey iron axe on a wooden handle. Plain soft background.

Archaeologists carefully excavating a trench layer by layer with small trowels and brushes. The trench wall shows clear horizontal soil layers of different colours. A broken clay pot and an old bone are visible in a deep layer. Sunny day, string grid over the dig.

A small group of Stone Age people of different ages sitting around a campfire outside a cave in green mountains, an elder telling a story while children listen. Animal-skin clothing. No dogs or wolves anywhere in the picture.

The Georgian legendary hero Amirani, a strong young man, chained to a rock high in the snowy Caucasus mountains, looking defiant, an eagle circling in the sky. Mythical, dramatic but suitable for children.

A big cross-section of the ground filling the whole picture, like a cake: four clear horizontal soil layers, light sandy on top and dark brown at the bottom. ONE whole clay pot sits in the top layer on the RIGHT side. ONE older broken clay pot sits in the bottom layer on the LEFT side, with small black pieces of charcoal from an old fire right next to it. Only a thin strip of grass and sky at the very top. No people, no buildings.

A tidy museum display case with five ancient fossil skull casts of early humans on small stands, each slightly different in shape, cream-coloured like old bone, calm educational museum scene with soft lighting.

An early human (Homo erectus) about 1.5 metres tall, walking upright on two legs across a grassy plain with low hills, holding a simple stone tool. Small head, strong brow ridge, no clothes except a little fur covering, shown respectfully, 1.8 million years ago.

A prehistoric landscape 1.8 million years ago in southern Georgia: a sabre-toothed cat with long fangs resting on a rock, and two giraffe-like animals eating from trees in the distance, open grassland with hills.
An old early human with almost no teeth sitting by a fire, while a younger early human gently offers soft mashed food. Shows kindness and care, 1.8 million years ago, simple and respectful.
A neat row of Stone Age tools on a flat rock: a rough pebble chopper, a teardrop-shaped hand axe, a flint scraper, a sharp spear point, thin stone blades, and a fine bone needle.

Inside a limestone cave in the hills of Imereti, a group of Stone Age hunter-gatherers sit around a warm fire. One cooks meat on a stick, another scrapes an animal skin with a flint scraper. Wild mountain goat horns hang on the wall. No dogs or wolves anywhere in the picture.
A microscope view of a few tiny ancient flax fibres on a light background: some fibres twisted like thread, some dyed in soft colours such as pink, black and turquoise. Round microscope view edge.

An early farming village about 8,000 years ago on a flat plain near a river: small round houses made of sun-dried mud bricks, close together, smoke from hearths, a wheat field, sheep and goats, people grinding grain on flat stones.
Neolithic farmers harvesting golden wheat with simple sickles with sharp black obsidian blades, on a plain with low hills, early morning light.
Domestication side by side: a wolf next to a dog, a wild goat next to a farm goat, a wild boar next to a pig, and a huge wild aurochs next to a cow, arranged in pairs in a green meadow.

Cross-section of a small grassy hill (a settlement mound). Inside the hill, only buried ruins: crumbled old mud-brick walls and broken pots in layers, the oldest at the very bottom. No people inside the hill. On the very top, a few small round mud-brick houses with people.
Close-up of Neolithic tools on a woven mat: shiny black obsidian blades (volcanic glass), a sickle with obsidian teeth, a bone awl, and a flat grinding stone with grain.
Bronze Age metalworkers at a clay furnace in a mountain valley of the Caucasus, one pumping bellows made of animal skin, glowing orange metal inside a small clay crucible.
A Bronze Age craftsman pouring glowing liquid bronze from a small clay crucible into an open stone mould shaped like an axe head. Finished bronze axes lie nearby.
The green Caucasus mountains with rocky slopes showing streaks of green and blue copper ore, a small Bronze Age miner's path winding up the hill.
Inside a narrow ancient gold mine tunnel about 5,000 years ago: miners break rock with heavy stone hammers by firelight, others wash crushed rock in a wooden trough to find gold flakes.
A huge grassy burial mound (kurgan) on a wide plain, made of earth and stones, with tiny people beside it showing how big it is. Calm, respectful, evening light.

A respectful cut-away view of a wooden burial chamber under a burial mound: clay pots for food and drink, bronze weapons and tools, and a little gold jewellery placed carefully. No skeleton shown, only the objects.
Inside an ancient wooden burial chamber, dimly lit, no people: a rare wooden wagon with four solid wooden wheels and carved decorations, wooden furniture and clay pots beside it. Bronze Age.

A tall ancient silver goblet with NO handle, a straight cup shape standing on a short foot, on a plain museum background. Around the top, a carved band shows a row of small people walking in a line carrying cups towards a person sitting beside a tree; around the bottom, a carved band shows a row of deer.
Inside an Early Bronze Age house: a round clay hearth in the middle of the floor with a fire, and a clay hearth stand shaped like a horseshoe decorated with ram's horns. A family sits around it.

An Early Bronze Age village on a terrace above a wide river valley: houses built close together with narrow lanes, walls of woven branches covered with clay, smoke from hearths, fields below by the river.
An Early Bronze Age village with wattle-and-daub houses burning at night, villagers running safely away carrying pots and children. Dramatic but not frightening.

Ancient Colchis wetlands: wooden houses on small man-made earth hills in a warm marsh with tall reeds and dense forest, ditches of water around, people paddling a long boat carved from a single tree trunk.
From the Greek myth: a shining golden fleece hanging on an oak tree in a sacred forest, guarded by a huge green dragon coiled around the tree, eyes wide open. In the sky, a golden ram flying away.
The ancient Greek ship Argo with a single square sail and many oars, full of heroes, sailing across a blue sea towards green mountains on the horizon. Mythical adventure.
Medea, a young princess of Colchis with magic, in a dark sacred forest at night, holding glowing herbs as the great dragon guarding the golden fleece falls asleep. A young Greek hero waits nearby.
In a mountain river in Svaneti, people lay a fleecy sheepskin in the shallow water; tiny gold flakes stick to the wool and glitter. Snowy Caucasus peaks behind.

Greek trading ships arriving at a small coastal trading town at the mouth of a river on the Black Sea coast, about 2,500 years ago. Local Colchian people and Greek traders swapping goods: clay amphorae on one side, wood, honey and linen on the other. Green forested hills behind. The ships are ancient Greek merchant ships with plain sails, no dragon or monster pictures.
In the hall of the Persian king, envoys from a distant mountain land bow and present gifts, while the king sits on a throne. Columns, richly dressed guards. Respectful, calm.
Ancient Colchian soldiers marching in a long army of many peoples, 480 BC: they wear wooden helmets, carry small round shields of raw ox hide, short spears and short swords.

A green kingdom in the middle: on the left, Greek ships on the sea bringing pottery and wine; on the right, Persian horsemen on the land bringing gold and silver gifts. Colchian people in the middle trading with both. Wide, simple, symbolic composition.

A medieval Georgian monk in the 11th century writing a long history book by candlelight in a stone monastery room, with a quill pen, old manuscripts piled around. The pages show only wavy lines, no readable writing.
A cruel foreign ruler in rich armour standing on a fortress wall in a river valley, frowning, while in the shadows below a mother hides with her young son, the future king Pharnavaz.
A young man asleep in an empty room dreams: a bright ray of sunlight comes through a small window, and he takes the light in his hands and rubs it on his face, which glows gold. Magical, symbolic.
A young hunter shelters from heavy rain in a cave and discovers a hidden treasure: heaps of gold coins, golden cups and jewellery shining in the dim light. Rain pours outside the cave mouth.
Two ancient rulers clasping hands in friendship in front of their armies in a mountain valley: a young king of eastern Georgia and the ruler of western Georgia, a princess standing nearby.
An ancient king of Kartli seated on a simple stone throne in a fortress hall, wearing a gold crown and a rich cloak, guards with spears beside him.
Ancient Rome: a temple with tall columns beside the river Tiber, Roman citizens in togas, soldiers with red shields, a golden eagle standard.

A small mountain kingdom in the middle, with a Roman army with an eagle standard on the left side and a Parthian army of horse archers on the right side. The small kingdom stands between the two big powers. Simple, symbolic composition.
Gift exchange between two ancient rulers: Roman servants lead an elephant as a gift to a Caucasian king, while his servants carry beautiful cloaks embroidered with gold thread to give in return.
Several luxurious ancient cloaks of deep purple and red cloth, richly embroidered with gold thread in swirling patterns, laid out on a table.
Nomad horsemen riding south through a deep, narrow mountain gorge between steep rocky cliffs, a river rushing below: the Darial Pass in the Greater Caucasus.
Inside an ancient Roman temple, a bronze statue of a king on horseback standing on a stone base, Roman visitors looking up at it.

A Persian king's stone tower with a long carved inscription on its wall, a proud king pointing at it, a historian with a scroll looking at it thoughtfully. The inscription is shown only as rows of tiny carved marks, not readable letters.
A large golden balance scale: on one pan a Roman golden eagle, on the other a Persian crown, and a small mountain kingdom with a fortress sitting on the beam in the middle. Symbolic.
Bronze Age miners digging into a mountain rock face with stone hammers and antler picks, chunks of rock with green copper ore in baskets. Close, simple composition.
A Bronze Age metalworker heating copper ore in a small clay furnace, a helper pumping leather bellows, glowing orange metal melting inside a small clay crucible. Close, simple composition.
A Bronze Age craftsman pouring glowing liquid bronze from a small clay crucible into an open stone mould shaped like an axe. Close, simple composition.
A Bronze Age craftsman hammering and sharpening a shiny new bronze axe head on a stone anvil, engraving a small animal pattern on it. Close, simple composition.
Modern archaeologists on a low grassy hill in a plain carefully digging up broken pieces of very large ancient clay jars. Close, simple composition.
A modern scientist in a laboratory with gloves scraping dark residue from inside a piece of ancient pottery into a small glass dish, a microscope beside her. Close, simple composition.
A bunch of purple grapes next to a small laboratory glass dish holding tiny white crystals, on a clean lab bench. Shows that the chemical comes from grapes. Close, simple composition.

Neolithic villagers about 8,000 years ago pouring grape juice into a very large clay jar partly buried in the ground, baskets of grapes beside them, small round mud-brick houses behind. Close, simple composition.
A Bronze Age chief with gold jewellery and a gold cup, sitting proudly with herds of animals and fields behind him. Close, simple composition.
Bronze Age warriors with bronze spears and a skilled craftsman making a bronze axe beside them. Close, simple composition.
Bronze Age farmers working in a field and herders with sheep and cattle on a hillside. Close, simple composition.

A sunny green mountain meadow in the Caucasus with wild flowers and snowy peaks far behind. The middle foreground is empty grass. No people, no animals, no buildings.
A cosy explorer's desk seen from the front: an old parchment map, rolled scrolls, a magnifying glass, a small clay pot and a candle, warm light. The middle of the desk is clear and empty. No people.
